products.title: SPN V3 RAW FORGED WEDGES
products.body_html: SPN V3 - "Are they as good as (insert here)?....No, they are better." We've invested on R&D heavily over the last two years to develop the SPN V3 wedges. Every shape was redesigned to completely eliminate any offset or "hosel notch"; making the leading edge of the hosel and the leading edge of the club head sit perfectly in line looking down at address. The improved overall head shapes with the enhanced perception screams "tour ready". We also redesigned our grooves and pushed them to the limit (literally the USGA limit on proximity) that not only works, but makes you feel like you have the ultimate tool in your hands. In the higher lofted wedges, significant weight was added to the top flange to help control launch conditions while still maximizing spin. Don't forget, SPN is your friend. As we said, we invest in R&D, not marketing...so tell all your friends for us.

products.title: NLU-V2 UTILITY Iron
products.body_html:
The original NLU-01 quickly became one of the most trusted utility irons in golf — praised for its versatility, clean design, and elite-level playability. Improving on that formula wasn’t easy. But after extensive testing and refinement, we’re proud to unveil the NLU-V2 — faster, more forgiving, and engineered to inspire confidence.

At its core, the V2 features a proven 431 stainless steel body, paired with a newly upgraded C300 forged face insert. This high-strength face delivers hotter ball speeds across the hitting surface while maintaining exceptional control. The feel? Slightly firmer than the original, yet still buttery smooth compared to most driving irons on the market.

Whether you’re attacking tight par 4s or need a reliable fairway finder off the tee, the NLU-V2 offers the ideal blend of power, precision, and playability.

products.title: 702 Series Demo Program
products.body_html:
With New level being a Direct-to-Consumer born brand that is still working on getting into fitters and retailers, our Demo Program allows you the ability to test our iron heads at a discounted price with a range of shafts that cover different weights and flexes. We record all the specs of your club. If you decide to purchase the rest of the set, but need to make changes to either the club head or shaft, please contact us at generalinquiry@newlevelgolf.com, and we will work with you to find the right setup and will simply rebuild you a new 7 iron at the same price of the demo. Give your old demo to a buddy and help us get New Level in more players hands!

  • This program is to test our iron heads, not for shaft fitting
  • The demo club is yours to keep, and the sale of the demo club is final.
  • We do not special order shafts for the demo program
  • If you do not see a shaft you want, you can purchase a single club at full price from the product specific page

*Please note that if you select the head-only option, we do not alter lie or loft angle.

products.title: NLU-01 UTILITY RIGHT HANDED
products.body_html: The NLU-01 utility iron provides unparalleled forgiveness and ball speed. The 431 stainless steel body is laser welded to a CS455 club face. Expect optimal sound and feel from this gorgeous beast! The unique design redistributes the weight towards the extremities of the club and provides higher launch angles and softer landings. Moreover, the reduced offset will appeal to the better player and provide the ultimate weapon for shot shaping on tight tee shots.

products.title: GI22 IRONS
products.body_html: After two-plus years of R&D, we are pleased to introduce our new gi22 game improvement irons. The gi22 blends handsome looks with maximum ball speed and unsurpassed forgiveness. They are the perfect iron for beginners, seniors, ladies, and those golfers looking to improve. The hollow-body construction and proprietary pocket design reduce unwanted vibration while providing a crisp feel and solid sound at impact. Don't be fooled by big-budget OEMs; New Level has you covered for a fraction of the cost of comparable irons.

products.title: NLH-01 Hybrid
products.body_html: The NLH-01 Hybrid has been designed specifically for those golfers that dislike the draw-biased nature of most hybrid clubs. The compact head size, tour-inspired shape, reduced offset; and Carpenter Steel face insert appeals to various player types. Each custom-built NLH-01 ships with a stock 8-gram weight. The adjustable weighting system allows you to tailor the swing weight to your feel preference and easily accommodates longer and shorter golf clubs with additional weight options of 4, 12, and 16 grams. Improve your long game, improve your scores with the NLH-01.
